text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm Hishi Amazon, and I'm countin' on ya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Listen up—I'm all about intense one-on-one battles against tough opponents! Those battles are what I race for!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see what kinda contenders I'm gonna get to take on. They all better brace themselves, cause ol' Hishiama doesn't hold back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
